metadata.short_desc: Register every tool, inject the manual on demand
metadata.desc: Named after Schrödinger's cat: a tool is both registered (it exists) and absent from the current request (invisible), and only collapses into a full schema the model can see once local retrieval "observes" and activates it. All tools are still registered with AstrBot, so upstream permissions (persona tool allow-lists, per-session plugin filtering, per-tool enable switches) keep applying. Before each request the plugin runs a local retrieval over the user's message and hands the model only the full schemas of the tools activated for that turn. It saves prompt budget and context window, not tool execution compute.

lazy-tools.title: Schrödinger's Toolbox
lazy-tools.description: Inspect the tool registry and per-session activation state, and dry-run retrieval to calibrate thresholds
lazy-tools.heading: Schrödinger's Toolbox
lazy-tools.subheading: Tools stay registered; manuals are injected on demand. Inspect the registry, per-session activation, and dry-run retrieval here.
lazy-tools.playground_hint: read-only, does not touch the activation table
lazy-tools.query_placeholder: Type what a user might say, e.g. echo this sentence back to me
lazy-tools.tools_hint: Tags drive lazy retrieval; edit and save them right here — changes go to the override layer, never to the source
lazy-tools.enrich: Fill in tags with an LLM
lazy-tools.sources_hint: When disabled, a sub-plugin's tools stop being retrieved and injected; the state is written back to the plugin config
lazy-tools.upload_hint: A single .py file, or a .zip containing __init__.py; delete the existing one first if the name is taken
lazy-tools.import_hint: Copy a plugin's source from data/plugins into sub_plugins/; only plain-function tool sets written with @lazy_tool are accepted
lazy-tools.learning_hint: Samples are the user's own wording from turns where the model actually called that tool; they outweigh hand-written examples in retrieval. Induction proposes words that recur across samples as tags
lazy-tools.learning_empty: Nothing learned yet. Chat normally, let the model use a tool, then come back and refresh. Only tools registered by this plugin are learned.
lazy-tools.learning_drop: Drop this sample (delete it if it was learned wrong)
